subject.title: fix(core): make indexed access explicit across remaining src (NUIA phase 3b)

question: After the two remaining absence regressions are repaired, should this protected broad phase land intact or be split into smaller owner-boundary changes?
rationale: The defects are mechanically repairable, but the maintainer-protected breadth and repeated ordinary-state regressions leave the acceptable audit and landing scope to the feature owner.

options.title: Repair and keep the phase intact
options.body: Fix both regressions, complete the fallback audit, add focused coverage and runtime proof, then review the exact head as one phase.

options.title: Split by owner boundary
options.body: Separate session/gateway, cron, plugin/channel, and remaining mechanical changes if maintainers cannot confidently establish whole-branch equivalence.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep the phase intact
recommendation.body: Fix both regressions, complete the fallback audit, add focused coverage and runtime proof, then review the exact head as one phase.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the phased rollout and the recent current-main history of the central affected surfaces.
